(fn PerformConditionCheckAI (OwnerController ControlledPawn)
  (Utilities|IsValid ControlledPawn
    (:"Is Valid"
      (bind _asmy_character (Utilities|Casting|CastToMyCharacter (AI|BehaviorTree|GetBlackboardValueAsActor (Variables|Default|GetTargetKey)))

(fn PerformConditionCheckAI (OwnerController ControlledPawn)
  (bind _targetkey (Variables|Default|GetTargetKey))
  (bind _returnvalue (AI|BehaviorTree|GetBlackboardValueAsActor _targetkey))
  (bind _returnvalue_yaw (Transformation|GetActorRotation _returnvalue))
  (bind _returnvalue_1 (Transformation|GetActorLocation _returnvalue))
  (bind _returnvalue_2 (Transformation|GetActorLocation ControlledPawn))
  (bind _returnvalue_yaw_1 (Math|Rotator|FindLookAtRotation _returnvalue_2 _returnvalue_1))
  (bind _returnvalue_3 (- _returnvalue_yaw_1 _returnvalue_yaw))
  (bind _returnvalue_4 (+ _returnvalue_3 180.000000))
  (bind _returnvalue_5 (Math|Float|%(Float) _returnvalue_4 360.000000))
  (bind _returnvalue_6 (- _returnvalue_5 180.000000))
  (bind _returnvalue_7 (Math|Float|Absolute(Float) _returnvalue_6))
  (bind _returnvalue_8 (< _returnvalue_7 120.000000))
  (Utilities|IsValid ControlledPawn
    (:"Is Valid"
      (AI|BehaviorTree|SetBlackboardValueAsBool (Variables|Default|GetIsBehindKey) _returnvalue_8)
      (return _returnvalue_8))
    (:"Is Not Valid"
      (return false))))

(fn PerformConditionCheckAI (OwnerController ControlledPawn)

  (Utilities|IsValid _returnvalue
    (:"Is Valid"
      (return (<= (Math|Vector|Distance2D(Vector) (Transformation|GetActorLocation _returnvalue) (Transformation|GetActorLocation (AI|BehaviorTree|GetBlackboardValueAsActor (Variables|Default|GetTargetKey)))) (AI|BehaviorTree|GetBlackboardValueAsFloat (Variables|Default|GetRangeKey)))))
    (:"Is Not Valid"
      (return false))))
